description.narrative: To resource women's rights organisations and feminist human rights activists impacted by the Russian invasion of Ukraine through the following strategies: Rapid response grants to address urgent humanitarian needs and resilience needs of women's rights groups; Grants to provide economic opportunities for displaced women; Coordination and platforms to share information on available humanitarian support, effective methodologies for replication, partnerships, etc to better support displaced Ukrainians in neighboring countries; Consultations and strategies for future rebuilding that include women's rights considerations and voices of diverse women's rights groups; Along with grantmaking, the Equality Fund and the organization will also collaborate within the network of feminist funds on areas such as mutual learning and exchange, advocacy and joint strategy development.
